spans.s:
mfn. (-यः-या-यी-यं)
Asleep, sleeping.
m. (-यः)
1 A hand.
2 A snake, (Boa constrictor.)
3 Sleep, sleeping.
4 A bed, a couch.
5 Abuse, imprecation.
E.
शी to sleep, aff. घ, or टच् or अच्.

f. (-य्या)
1 A bed, a couch, a sofa.
2 Tying in knots, stringing.
E.
शी to sleep, क्यप् aff., and अयङ् substituted for the vowel.

m. (-यः)
1 Evening, close of day.
2 An arrow.
3 End, close in general.
E.
षो to end or destroy, &c., घञ् aff.

mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डी-ण्डं)
Asleep, sleeping.
E.
शी to sleep, अण्डच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
Asleep, sleeping.
m. (-थः)
1 Death, dying.
2 A sort of snake, the Boa.
E.
शी to sleep, अथच् Uṇādi aff.

Sleep.
2

A bed, a couch.
3 Copulation.
E.
शी to sleep, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Sleeping, asleep.
E.
शी to sleep, शानच् aff.

n. (-नं)
The longitude of a planet reckoned from the vernal equinoctial point.
E.
स with, अयन the equinoctial period.

n. (-हं)
A bed chamber.
E.
शयन, and गृह house.

m. (-रः)
A bed chamber.
E.
शयन, and आगार house.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Fit for or suitable to sleep, to be slept on, &c.
n. (-यं)
A bed, a couch.
E.
शी to sleep, अनीयर् aff. of the future participle; also with कन् added शयनीयक n. (-कं)

f. (-शी)
The eleventh day of the light half of Āṣārha, on which VIṢṆU'S sleep commences.
E.
शयन, and एकादशी eleventh lunation.

m. (-कः)
1 A snake.
2 A chamæleon, a lizard.
E.
शी to sleep, आनक् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु)
Sleepy, slothful, sluggish.
m. (-लुः)
1 A snake, the

Boa.
2

A dog.
3 A Shakāl.
E.
शी to sleep, आलुच् aff.; implying disposition or habit.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Asleep.
m. (-तं)
A plant, (Cordia myxa).
n. (-तं)
Sleep, sleeping.
E.
शी to sleep, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Sleeping, asleep.
E.
शीङ् to sleep, क्तवतु aff.

ind.
Having slept.
E.
शी to sleep, क्त्वा aff.

m. (-युः)
A large snake, (Boa.)
E.
शी to sleep, and उ Uṇādi aff.

m. (-नः)
A large kind of snake, (Boa.)
E.
शीङ् to sleep, Uṇādi aff. उनन्.

m. (-कः)
1 An arrow.
2 A sword.
E.
शो to destroy, ण्वुल् aff.; also सायक.

m. (-कः)
1 An arrow.
2 A sword.
f. (-यिका)
Standing in order.
E.
षो to destroy, ण्वुल् aff.

f. (-का)
Sleeping.
E.
शी to sleep, ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Lying down.
E.
शी to sleep, णिनि aff.

m. (-यी)
A horseman, a groom.
E.
स for सह with, अय to go, णिनि aff.

mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं)
Endeavouring, taking pains.
n. adv. (-त्नं)
Vigorously, assiduously.
E.
स with, यत्न effort.

INDRA.
2

Proximity to a wife.
3 A pair of nippers for cutting betel-nut.
E.
स for सह with, or सम् like, and योनि pudendum muliebre.

m. (-लः)
Eventide, evening.
E.
सायम् evening, and काल time.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Belonging to the evening.
E.
साय evening, and द्यु aff.

ind.
Evening, close of the day, in the evening. See साय.

n. (-नं)
The place or time of sunset.
E.
साय, and मण्डन embellishing.

m. (-ह्नः)
The evening, eventide.
E.
सायम् evening, and अहन् day.

n. (-ज्यं)
1 Likeness, similarity.
2 Identification, intimate union, (especially with the Deity.)
E.
स with, युज what joins, ष्यञ् aff.

ind.
In the evening, at the close of the day.
E.
साय evening, the seventh case, used as a particle.
